title: Stuck Upside Down With No Way to Back Out

lines.text: He was stuck head-down, hundreds of feet inside a cave.
He couldn't turn around. He couldn't back out.
The rescuers' plan: pull him back up the way he came.
Deep in the cave, he squeezed head-first into a narrow passage.
It ran downward. He slid in until he was wedged, upside down.
Rescuers rigged ropes and pulleys, anchored into the rock.
At first, it seemed to work.
For the first time in hours, there was hope.
Then, reports say, an anchor gave way.
He slid straight back into the crack.
Rescuers kept working, hour after hour.
After about 27 hours, John Jones died in the cave.
Recovering him was reportedly judged too dangerous for rescuers.
So the cave was sealed with concrete, with him still inside.
Nutty Putty Cave is now his resting place.

shots.description: COLD OPEN, frame 1 already moving. Dry cave: a narrow crack in pale, clay-smeared rock drops steeply away from camera. At the top of frame, two boots and the lower legs of a caver stick out of the crack, the rest of him out of sight below. His helmet lamp glows somewhere down inside the crack. Dust hangs in the air.
shots.camera: Slow push-in 28 mm from the crawlway behind the boots, looking down the crack; subtle handheld (amp 0.02).
characters: caver_John (faceless figure, brown coveralls, red helmet; only boots and legs visible)
shots.lighting: Black cave; warm helmet-lamp glow from inside the crack; faint cool fill from behind camera.

shots.description: 2.5D side cross-section: beige-grey rock mass, a funnel-shaped crack angled steeply downward from a crawlway at top-left. A simple grey outline figure sits inverted in the funnel's narrow end. Two arrows appear: one pointing down (deeper, blocked, red X) and one pointing back up (blocked, red X).
shots.camera: Locked full-frame diagram; 5% zoom-in onto the figure.
shots.lighting: Flat graphic; black background, cyan rock edge, red X marks.

shots.description: Low crawlway lit by several helmet lamps: faceless rescuers in coveralls drag coils of rope and a small pulley bag toward the crack, lamps bobbing.
shots.camera: Low 24 mm at floor level, rescuers crawl toward camera; slow pull-back.
characters: rescuer figures x3 (faceless, helmets with lamps)
shots.lighting: Multiple moving helmet lamps; warm light on clay walls.

shots.description: Night exterior: a low, bare desert hill under a cold starry sky, sagebrush (small bare-tree builder, scaled down) and a small dark cave opening in the hillside. Rescue vehicles' lights glow at the bottom of the hill.
shots.camera: Descending crane 28 mm toward the cave opening.
shots.lighting: Moonlight blue; warm vehicle lights far below.

shots.description: Earlier the same evening: a lone caver figure (faceless, red helmet, lamp on) stands at the cave opening seen from behind, then ducks inside.
shots.camera: Medium 35 mm from behind, slight dolly-in.
shots.lighting: Helmet lamp as key; moonlight rim.

shots.description: POV crawl: helmet-lamp view of a tight, clay-walled tube; two gloved hands reach forward and pull. The tube tilts and narrows ahead into a dark slot.
shots.camera: First-person 20 mm, crawl bob (amp 0.04), forward push.

shots.description: 2.5D side cross-section: beige-grey rock mass, a funnel-shaped crack angled steeply downward from a crawlway at top-left. The grey outline figure slides from the crawlway into the crack and down to its narrow end, ending inverted. A dotted trail marks the path.
shots.camera: Locked diagram; slow tilt down following the figure.

shots.description: Close-up in the crawlway: gloved hands drive a bolt anchor into the rock ceiling above the crack, clip a pulley to it and thread a rope through. The rope runs down into the crack.
shots.camera: Macro 50 mm, quick cuts within the shot (bolt, clip, rope) via fast camera moves.
shots.lighting: Two helmet lamps, warm, hard shadows.

shots.description: 2.5D side cross-section: beige-grey rock mass, a funnel-shaped crack angled steeply downward from a crawlway at top-left. The rope runs from the ceiling anchor down to the outline figure's feet. The figure inches up the crack: a cyan progress trail grows behind it.
Rescuers in a line along the crawlway haul on the taut rope together, lamps all pointing toward the crack; the light seems warmer and brighter.
shots.camera: Side tracking 28 mm along the line of rescuers.

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN. Close-up on the ceiling anchor: a crack runs through the rock around the bolt, then it tears out. The rope whips slack and dust bursts across the lamps.
shots.camera: Macro 50 mm on the anchor; hard shake on the failure (amp 0.08) for 6 frames.
shots.lighting: Lamp light strobes as the rope whips through the beams.

shots.description: 2.5D side cross-section: beige-grey rock mass, a funnel-shaped crack angled steeply downward from a crawlway at top-left. The cyan progress trail drains back down; the outline figure slides back to the narrow end. The rope hangs slack from an empty anchor point.
shots.camera: Locked; no movement except the figure; 0.4 s silence after the line.
shots.lighting: Graphic; progress trail turns red as it drains.

shots.description: Dim crawlway. Rescuers' lamps flicker, some figures resting against the wall, others still working at the crack; the rope is being re-rigged.
shots.lighting: Tired, lower lamp light; cool fill.

shots.description: 2.5D side cross-section: beige-grey rock mass, a funnel-shaped crack angled steeply downward from a crawlway at top-left. Final state of the section. The small lamp icon on the outline figure's helmet dims and goes out. The outline then fades to a faint line in the rock. No body detail is shown.
shots.camera: Locked; very slow zoom-out; 0.7 s silence after the line.

shots.description: The crawlway from S03, now emptying: the last rescuer lamps withdraw up the passage away from camera until only darkness and a coiled rope remain.
shots.camera: Static 24 mm at floor level, lamps recede.
shots.lighting: Receding warm lamps; ends near black.

shots.description: Daylight on the bare hillside: grey concrete pours down into the cave opening from a chute, filling it. Cut within the shot to a flat, finished concrete slab where the opening was.
shots.camera: High 28 mm looking down into the opening; slow crane up as the slab settles.

shots.description: Dawn over the quiet hill. The sealed concrete slab sits flush in the hillside among the sagebrush, wind moving the brush. Final frame held, then hard cut to black.
shots.camera: Very slow push-in 35 mm toward the slab; hard cut at the end.

overlay.text:
IN MEMORY OF
JOHN EDWARD JONES
